woorden.Monumentale panden zijn lastig te isoler: Listed buildings are hard to insulate and hard to take off gas. Electrification also tends to run aground on grid congestion. A compost heating system delivers heat entirely independent of the electricity grid, from material you currently pay to have taken away.
